## Specific task description

Task instruction: Put the two breads the palm-sized braided golden bread and the round braided loaf in the breadbasket with hollowed white walls.

Task description: Put both golden woven-pattern loaves currently on either side of the basket into the bread basket in the center with white perforated sides.

Success criteria: Both pieces of bread have been placed in the basket, near its center horizontally and within the basket above the tabletop. Both grippers are open and the bread has been released.

## Execution tips

- Approach the bread from above and grip fuller surfaces around the middle of two opposite sides, opening slightly wider than that section. Before closing, confirm the pads surround both sides, avoiding gripping only the top texture or pushing the bread away.
- When moving toward the basket, keep both the bread bottom and fingertips above the white rim, leaving clearance for lateral movement to avoid hitting the basket or catching fingers in its open grid.
- When placing the other piece of bread, use the remaining space near the middle of the basket and offset it from the first piece. Leave room for the gripper to open so it does not push the placed bread toward the rim.
- Before release, let the bread rest securely on the basket bottom or another piece of bread. After opening, withdraw upward where possible to reduce dropping, rolling, or catching the basket wall.
